statement: The wallet shown as 'YOU' on SolanaSwaggy's stream bought in the creation second of every token launched by deployer DbwyGZ5D… in the recorded window, with a fixed size and a twin wallet.

SolanaSwaggy (or someone coordinating with them) launches tokens — including copycats of names trending on their Pulse screen — and buys the launch in the same block with fixed-size wallets, selling into the first seconds of bot demand. On this evidence their on-stream profit is at least partly launch-and-snipe, not discretionary selection.
